job.title: Digital Marketing Strategist @ SQLI (Sint-Martens-Latem, Flemish Region, Belgium)
job.description:
**We Elevate. Digitally.**

SQLI is a European player and market leader in customer experience and digital transformation, helping major international brands create value through technology and digital innovation. From strategy to the effective implementation of technological solutions, we design and build robust, high-performance architectures and engaging digital experiences, combining advanced technologies, proven methodologies, and deep expertise.

To strengthen our teams (2,200 employees across 12 countries), we are looking for driven talent who share our values: Creativity, Engagement, and a Future-minded approach.

SQLI Ghent creative agency; that’s us: 50+ digital specialists working every day on projects that truly matter. For brands like Colruyt Group, Brustor, Pierre Fabre, and Jules Destrooper, we build digital strategies, campaigns, and platforms that make a real impact. As part of an international group, we have the scale and expertise of a large agency, while operating with the commitment and agility of a local team.

SQLI is a European market leader in customer experience, digital marketing and digital transformation.

*Together with with digital leaders and CMO’s of ambitious brands we work across strategy, experience design, digital marketing, and ecommerce to shape platforms and experiences that truly matter.*

*That’s where you come in.*

**This position is only open to candidates who will be employed directly by us. We do not work with contractors or agencies for this role.**

**Job Description**

*Make brands worth following.*

Social moves fast. Brands do not win by chasing every trend or publishing more of the same. They win by understanding where they belong, how they should behave and why people should care.

As a Senior Social & Content Strategist at SQLI, you define how brands show up across social platforms, culture and communities. You connect audience behaviour, platform dynamics, content, creators, community and paid distribution into a social ecosystem that earns attention and delivers results.

You combine creative instinct with strategic discipline. You know what makes an idea platform-native, but you can also explain how it supports the brand and business objective. You turn that thinking into a sharp client story, a clear tactical plan and briefs that creative and media teams can act on.

*You understand the scroll. But more importantly, you understand the strategy behind stopping it.*

What you will do

* Define the role of social within a brand’s wider digital and marketing strategy.

* Develop social strategies, annual plans and campaign approaches.

* Make clear platform choices across TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, Pinterest, Reddit and emerging channels.

* Build distinctive content territories, formats and editorial systems.

* Connect organic content, paid social, influencers, creators, UGC and community management.

* Translate cultural, audience and platform insights into relevant creative opportunities.

* Brief and challenge content, creative, influencer, community and performance specialists.

* Use social and content data to improve formats, creative choices and distribution.

* Decide where brands should invest, experiment, scale - or stay away.

* Turn social strategy into a persuasive story and confidently present it to clients.

**Qualifications**

What you bring

* 5+ years of experience in social, content, creative or influencer strategy, preferably in an agency.

* Deep knowledge of platform behaviour, social culture, creators and communities.

* Experience developing complete social strategies - not only calendars, concepts or channel plans.

* Strong understanding of both organic and paid social.

* The ability to recognise strong creative work and make it strategically stronger.

* Fluency in social performance metrics and the judgement to look beyond vanity metrics.
* Excellent storytelling, deck-building and presentation skills.
* Confidence in client conversations, workshops and pitches.
* The ability to turn ambitious ideas into focused, feasible tactical plans.
* Fluency in Dutch and English. French is an advantage.

**Additional Information**

*A challenging role is important, but so is the environment around it.*

At SQLI, you’ll work on varied projects for leading brands such as Nestlé, Colruyt, Pierre Fabre and Jaguar Land Rover. You won’t spend years working on the same platform or solving the same problems. Each client brings new challenges, giving you the opportunity to broaden your experience and keep developing your expertise.

* You’ll have the freedom to take ownership and make an impact. Your ideas will be heard, your expertise will be trusted and the work you deliver will be visible across the company. You won’t simply step into a predefined role. You’ll have the opportunity to shape it as you grow.
* And we’ll actively support that growth. Through dedicated R&D time, training, certifications, seminars, mentoring, events and regular knowledge sharing, you’ll have the space to explore new technologies and strengthen the skills that matter to you. Regular feedback and development conversations will help you decide what your next step should look like.
* As part of SQLI Group, you’ll also become part of an
  **international network of 2,200 colleagues across 12 countries**
  .
  *You’ll exchange knowledge with experts from different markets, work with international teams and gain exposure to projects beyond Belgium.*
* We offer flexibility in how you organise your work, while still making time to come together as a team. Our recently redesigned office in Sint-Martens-Latem offers outdoor space, informal meeting areas and comfortable places to focus or recharge. Regular drinks and team events give us the chance to connect outside the usual (project) meetings.
* You’ll receive a competitive salary package that reflects your experience, including a company car, an Apple laptop, a phone subscription and everything else you need to do your job well.
* Most importantly, you’ll join a welcoming and experienced team where people share knowledge, challenge each other constructively and step in when someone needs support.

*At SQLI, we help ambitious brands turn digital complexity into meaningful growth by bringing strategy, marketing, design and technology together.*

Our values are straightforward:

* *Curiosity*
* *Pragmatism*
* *Achievement*
* *Trust*

They shape how we collaborate, make decisions and communicate: openly, directly and without unnecessary complexity.

**Interested?**

*If you’re looking for challenging work, genuine ownership, international opportunities and the freedom to keep growing, let’s talk.*

Colgate-Palmolive Company is a global consumer products company operating in over 200 countries specialising in Oral Care, Personal Care, Home Care, Skin Care, and Pet Nutrition. Our products are trusted in more households than any other brand in the world, making us a household name!  
  
Join Colgate-Palmolive, a caring, innovative growth company reimagining a healthier future for people, their pets, and our planet. Guided by our core values—Caring, Inclusive, and Courageous—we foster a culture that inspires our people to achieve common goals. Together, let's build a brighter, healthier future for all.

job.description:
👋 Who we are
  
  
**About The Company**
Visit our Welcome To The Jungle homepage to learn more about AssoConnect and why you should join us!
  
  
AssoConnect : pictures, videos, company information
  
  
**A ScaleUp that Transforms Nonprofit Management**
**Market Leaders:**
AssoConnect is the leading software for nonprofit management in France, one of the largest markets in the world with over 1.5M nonprofits! We are also expanding in the U.S. with our Springly brand.
  
  
**Impact-driven:**
AssoConnect helps over 40,000 nonprofits by saving their time, energy, and money. We allow them to spend more time on their purpose and facilitate their communication with their members and donors.
  
  
**Ambitious growth, entrepreneurial spirit:**
Backed by team.blue since May 2025, we're scaling fast across Europe with both organic and external growth. While staying true to our roots (same team, same mission) we now have the resources of a European powerhouse to build the new standard for nonprofit management.
  
  
**Why you should join AssoConnect**
**Impact:**
You will have the unique opportunity to work in a scale-up positively impacting the world. At your level, you will substantially impact shaping the company's future.
  
  
**Fast-paced, continuous learning:**
We believe in investing in our team's learning through ongoing coaching and training. You will be coached by your peers and the best external advisors.
  
  
**Culture & Team spirit:**
We don’t compromise on our values: Simplicity, Excellence, Benevolence.
  
  
🎭 The role
  
  
Organisation
  
  

* Report to the Head of Marketing.
* Join a Marketing team including another Growth Marketer focused on build/engineering, a Content team of 2, and external partners (SEA agency, Com & Community freelancer).
* Daily collaboration with Content, Product, Sales and Ops.
* Full-time position, hybrid, based in Paris or Marseille.

Missions
  
  
We are looking for a
**full-stack Growth Marketer who builds**
. Your north star is clear: generate traffic, leads, and signups, and convert them.
  
  
You're as much a marketer as you are a builder. You understand our persona, you're happy to call customers, and you know what message converts. And you turn those insights into reality yourself, shipping acquisition tools, automations and AI-powered experiences with low-code and AI.
  
  
Our model is not sales-led. We serve thousands of small organizations that sign up on their own, so growth works a lot like e-commerce acquisition: heavy on SEO, organic and content, reaching people one by one at scale. The difference is that you need to know our product depth to know exactly who to go after and what will speak to them. You will own growth across the entire funnel, including CRM and marketing automation.
  
  
This is not a pure RevOps / ops role, nor a pure paid-media role. It is a hybrid marketer-builder.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own acquisition across channels: paid with partners, social and affiliation, plus new acquisition levers you build (low-code, AI, programmatic and satellite/SEO pages, free tools).
* Drive signups and conversion: optimize funnels (visits > leads > trial > signup), landing pages and conversion assets through A/B testing and CRO.
* Own lead generation and nurturing that push visitors to signup and trial (content, lead magnets, landing pages, email sequences).
* Own marketing automation and CRM for acquisition and activation journeys (lead scoring, routing, lifecycle). You make it yours, hands-on, as a growth lever, not as a systems admin.
* Build growth tools with low-code and AI: client-facing experiences, automations, enrichment, programmatic approaches. We expect concrete, pioneering use cases, not yet another workflow.
* Feed, prioritize and ship the growth backlog. Work self-serve on data to measure and iterate fast.
* Contribute to scaling our acquisition playbook internationally.
* Understand the persona deeply (interviews, user journey analysis)

**🔧 Required Qualifications**
💡: don’t forget Values & Leadership Principles
  
  
Profile
  
  
**Required**

* 4-8 years in growth, digital marketing or performance marketing, in SaaS or e-commerce, ideally on a complex product (subscriptions, multiple offers, activation and conversion mechanics).
* Both a marketer and a builder: a proven track record on acquisition channels AND hands-on building with low-code (Zapier, Make, Retool, Webflow or equivalent) and AI.
* Real, pushed AI use cases you can demo: client-facing or growth tooling, in practice, not in theory.
* Comfortable owning marketing automation and CRM (HubSpot or similar) as a growth lever, hands-on.
* Persona and message sensitivity: you understand users and what makes them convert, and you are not afraid to talk to customers.
* Data-autonomous in a self-service setup: you pull, read and prioritize without needing a data team to move.
* Fluent in English.
* Multi-market / international experience is a plus.

**We are NOT looking for**

* A pure RevOps / ops profile (systems, back-office workflows only).
* A pure media buyer with no build or messaging depth.

**Desired traits**

* Builder at heart and doer: you ship, you iterate, you don't just design processes.
* Analytical and data-driven, focused on performance and ROI.
* Pioneer on AI: you constantly test new tools and integrate them into your work.
* Autonomous, well-organized, strong project manager.
* Curious, coachable, culture of efficiency.

Salary
  
  
Up to 70K€ depending on experience.
  
  
🕵️ Recruitment process
  
  

* Screening
* Spend 1h with the HR and our Head of Marketing to check the fit between what you are looking for and what we are offering.
* Technical Skills
* Complete a 2-hour use case at home, followed by an interview with your manager to debrief on the use case and deep dive into your experience and skills.
* Talk about Business
* Validate technical expertise and business thinking. Ensure cultural fit, strategy mindset and alignment with our mission.
* Meet the team
* Meet your peers within the marketing team and join us for a lunch or a drink at our Paris or Marseille Office.
* Final HR steps
* Ref check and final discussion about salary, start date, and logistics.

**Recruitment date: ASAP.**
**The AssoConnect adventure began in 2014. Our three founders are young entrepreneurs, deeply involved in the non-profit world.**
Arnaud is involved with medical and social organizations that work for autistic children. Sylvain is involved with the scouts and his ultimate club. Pierre devotes much of his time to civil protection. Their passions for technology and the nonprofit world are just waiting to merge.
  
  
Little by little, the idea is growing💡

job.description:
**A propos**
------------

Le Centre Hospitalier Victor Jousselin est l’établissement de référence du bassin drouais (140 000 habitants), au nord du département de l’Eure-et-Loir, à proximité des régions Ile-de-France (Yvelines) et Normandie (Eure), au sein du GHT « Eure-et-Loir » sans concurrence directe sur son bassin de population.

L’établissement compte 761 lits et places ; il couvre l’ensemble des disciplines médicales sur les secteurs MCO et EHPAD et dispose d’un plateau technique complet. L’établissement offre toute la gamme de diagnostic et de soins en médecine, chirurgie et obstétrique ainsi que les soins de suite et de longue durée.

Avec une offre de soins et de services étendue, le centre hospitalier Victor-Jousselin est doté de nombreux atouts : référence départementale pour la prise en charge de la douleur, référence régionale pour l'éducation thérapeutique, chirurgie ambulatoire, imagerie médicale à la pointe de la haute technologie. L’établissement est également le siège départemental du SAMU, du Cegidd et de la Procréation Médicale Assistée.

Dans le cadre du projet médical d’établissement, un projet majeur de reconstruction concernant l’intégralité de l’offre MCO est envisagé à l’horizon 2030.

Rejoindre le CH de Dreux, c’est aussi :

* Un accès à des plateaux techniques complets et performants

* La possibilité d’accéder au statut de fonctionnaire

* Un soutien pour votre évolution professionnelle et un accès à la formation continue et aux études promotionnelles

* Un restaurant du personnel, des séances bien-être gratuites pour les personnels, la présence sur site d’une correspondante CGOS (prestations et loisirs) et MNH (mutuelle)

*Dans le cadre de sa politique diversité, les postes du CH de Dreux sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.*

**Votre mission**
-----------------

En tant que **chargé(e) de communication**, vous concevez, coordonnez et mettez en œuvre la politique de communication interne et externe du Centre Hospitalier Victor Jousselin, en lien direct avec la Direction générale et le Secrétariat général.

Vos missions principales :

* **Stratégie de communication** : participer à la définition de la stratégie globale, élaborer le plan de communication annuel et garantir la cohérence de l'image et de l'identité visuelle.

Als Content Creator maak je het beeldmateriaal waarmee Partnify zich laat zien: van productvideo's tot animaties en social content. Je werkt samen, met Marin van Loon, en haalt je input op bij collega's, klanten en partners. Je werkt vooral aan:

#### **Your team**

At Noxtua, we're building European Legal Intelligence: Legal Agents that prepare review-ready work for legal professionals across Europe. Our marketing team's mission is to make Noxtua the name legal professionals across Europe know and trust.

As our **Content & Campaign Manager (m/f/d)**, you'll turn marketing objectives into campaign ideas, compelling stories and high-quality content, with a strong focus on video. You'll own the creative process from the first idea to the final asset: concepts, scripts, briefs and production. You'll work hand in hand with our Social Media Manager, who owns publishing, community management and performance analysis, and with internal experts, filmmakers and external agencies to bring our campaigns to life.

You'll report to **Rafael Arcoverde**, Brand Marketing Lead, who has spent 19 years in marketing, working on projects for clients including Warner Bros., Hornbach, McDonald's, Sheraton, Red Bull, Unilever and Bunge. His background is in Social Communication (Advertising), and he holds an MBA with a specialisation in Marketing. He has worked in hyper-growth tech start-ups and with global teams.

#### **About you**

* You have **4 years plus** in content marketing, campaign management, creative strategy or a similar role, with a strong understanding of social media content formats and digital storytelling.
* **Creative partners:** experience briefing and coordinating filmmakers, creative agencies, and other creative partners.
* Your **storytelling & scriptwriting, and copywriting** skills are strong and shown in a portfolio of campaigns and video content you've shaped.
* Video production: practical experience with **video content production**, including production workflows and pre-production.
* You run **several campaigns and deadlines** at once, with a creative mindset and a structured, hands-on approach to execution.
* Communication & languages: excellent communication and collaboration skills. Fluent in **English; German** is a plus

#### **Your responsibilities**

* **Develop campaign concepts**: create year-round campaigns for social media and other digital channels, turning marketing objectives into content ideas, campaign narratives and creative formats, and bring in new storytelling approaches and video formats.
* **Shape the content and campaign roadmap**: contribute to the annual roadmap and align it with the Social Media Manager's strategy and publishing calendar.
* **Write scripts and set creative direction**: write scripts, storylines, creative briefs and content outlines for video-led campaigns, setting messaging, tone of voice, visual references and storytelling approach.
* **Run production end to end:** plan and coordinate production with filmmakers, agencies and other partners, brief and direct them, and manage timelines, deliverables, feedback rounds and approvals through to final delivery.
* **Adapt content for every platform:** turn each campaign concept into formats and variations for the relevant platforms, consistent with our brand identity and communication objectives.
* **Align and hand over:** gather insights and align messaging with internal teams, and hand finished assets over to the Social Media Manager for publishing and distribution.

#### **Our offer to you**

Building **Europe's sovereign Legal AI** is ambitious, meaningful work — and we want the people doing it to be properly looked after. Our benefits are built around flexibility, real-time off to recharge, and the setup to do your best work from wherever you are.

* **Remote**: 100% remote work possible (given a German residence), other countries upon request
* **Working hours**: Flexible working hours
* **Vacation:** 26 days + **December 24th & 31st off**, + 1 additional vacation day per year of employment (up to 30 days)
* **Discounts**: e.g., Urban Sports Club Membership, depending on location
* **Equipment**: Laptop (Lenovo or Mac), plus a home office setup budget (paid with your first salary)

#### **About us**

Noxtua (noxtua.com) is Europe's Legal AI built for legal professionals in law firms, legal departments, public administration, and the judiciary. Its AI covers the full workflow of legal text work: research, analysis of complex legal issues, and document drafting. Noxtua is built to meet the professional, criminal, and data protection requirements specific to the legal profession — including Section 203 of the German Criminal Code and Section 43e of the Federal Code for Lawyers — and holds certifications including BSI C5, ISO 27001, and ISO 42001. In partnership with leading European legal publishers, Noxtua is also building Europe's largest legal database, with more than 130 million searchable documents, and offering the market's first cross-continental European license.  
  
Founded in 2017 in Berlin on research by Dr. Leif-Nissen Lundbæk and Professor Dr. Michael Huth at Oxford University and Imperial College London, the company has offices in Paris, Berlin, Stockholm, Zagreb, Munich and Fribourg. Strategic investors include C.H.BECK, and MANZ, who have committed around €100 million as part of a Series C round in 2026.  
  
**We explicitly encourage women to apply, as they are currently underrepresented. Our goal is to build a diverse and inclusive work environment that values different perspectives. Of course, we welcome applications from all qualified individuals – regardless of gender, ethnic origin, religion, disability, age, or sexual identity.**

**About WPP Media**
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.
  
  
WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.
  
  
For more information, visit wppmedia.com.
  
  
Wir bei T&P verstehen uns als datengetriebene Kommunikationsagentur, deren Mission es ist, Kreativität, Technologie und Daten auf neue, aufregende und effektive Weise zu verknüpfen. Wir nennen es das &Modell und die Prämisse ist einfach: Kreation, Strategie, Media und Daten/CRM arbeiten Hand in Hand und lösen Herausforderungen als ein Team, das nah und partnerschaftlich mit dem Kunden zusammenarbeitet.
  
  
**Das Bieten Wir Dir**

* Work-Life-Balance: Dank flexibler Arbeitszeiten mit Schwerpunkt auf dem persönlichen Austausch im Office und ergänzender Remote Work passt sich dein Job deinem Leben an. Überstunden kannst du flexible ausgleichen.
* Vacation mode on: Du erhältst 30 Urlaubstage plus einen flexiblen Tag – zusätzlich sind der 24. und 31.12. frei.
* Wellbeing first: Gesundheitsleistungen, attraktive Altersvorsorge sowie Mental Health Awareness Days stellen deine Gesundheit in den Mittelpunkt.
* Practice makes perfect: Entfalte dich mit unseren vielfältigen Weiterbildungen und nutze unsere internen Karriereprogramme für deine Entwicklung im WPP-Netzwerk.
* More than just a job: Dich erwarten unvergessliche Events, Mitarbeitendenrabatte und weitere Highlights wie das Job Ticket, Wellhub oder das Job Bike.
* Be yourself: Bei uns ist jede:r herzlich willkommen - Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit liegen uns am Herzen.

**Das Bewegst Du**
Als
**Junior Social Media Manager**
bist du die direkte Stimme unserer Marken im Netz: Du betreust Communities auf allen relevanten Plattformen, steuerst das Publishing und triffst mit deinen Texten genau den richtigen Ton.
  
  

* Community Management & Brand Voice: Du betreust die Kanäle auf TikTok, Meta, LinkedIn und YouTube nahbar im täglichen Austausch. Du beantwortest DMs, moderierst Kommentare und triffst immer den perfekten Markenton.
* Publishing & Content-Organisation: Über gängige Publishing-Tools pflegst, terminierst und veröffentlichst du Beiträge, Reels, Stories sowie TikToks verlässlich nach Redaktionsplan.
* Copywriting & Captions: Mit treffenden Begleittexten, starken Hooks und relevanten Hashtags verleihst du visuellen Assets auf allen Plattformen den passenden textlichen Rahmen und du magst es dabei auch mit AI Tools zu arbeiten.
* Trend-Scouting & Recherche: Auf Plattformen wie TikTok und Instagram screenst du laufend aktuelle Trends, Sounds, Memes sowie Creator-Formate und bringst frische Impulse aktiv in die Content-Planung ein.
* Reporting & KPI-Tracking: Gemeinsam mit dem Team erstellst du monatliche Reportings, behältst wichtige Kennzahlen wie Engagement Rate, Views und Follower-Wachstum im Blick und leitest daraus erste Learnings ab.
* Paid Social & Boosting: Starke Posts machst du noch sichtbarer: In Abstimmung mit den Media-Kolleg:innen steuerst du bezahlte Reichweite für Top-Beiträge ein und unterstützt beim Aufsetzen erster Werbekampagnen.

**Das Zeichnet Dich Aus**

* Social-Media-Gespür: Du lebst Social Media privat wie beruflich. Ob TikTok, Instagram oder LinkedIn: Du weißt intuitiv, wie die Plattformen ticken und welcher Content Communities begeistert.
* Schreibtalent und Kommunikationsstärke: Mit feinem Sprachgefühl und hoher Empathie triffst du für jede Zielgruppe den richtigen Ton und reagierst im direkten Community-Dialog schnell, nahbar und markenadäquat.
* Zahlenverständnis: Daten und Reportings interessieren dich, um den Erfolg von Content messbar und nachvollziehbar zu machen.
* Paid-Social-Grundlagen: Ein erstes Verständnis für Tools wie den Meta Werbeanzeigenmanager oder TikTok Ads ist vorhanden, verbunden mit der Motivation, tiefer in Kampagnen-Setups und Post-Boostings einzusteigen.
* Deine Arbeitsweise: Du bist gut organisiert, arbeitest gewissenhaft und behältst auch bei kurzfristigen Abstimmungen, Deadlines und Freigabeschleifen stets den Überblick.

Darüber hinaus bist du:
**#kreativ #kommunikativ #proaktiv**
Wenn du diesen Job spannend findest, dann ermutigen wir dich ausdrücklich zur Bewerbung, auch wenn du nicht jede oben gelistete Qualifikation aufweisen kannst.
  
  
**Arbeiten Bei WPP Media**
Als WPP Media gestalten wir die Zukunft der Medien und investieren dabei konsequent in unsere Mitarbeiter:innen. Jede:r Kolleg:in genießt die Vorteile des globalen Netzwerks von WPP Media und WPP, um sich weiterzuentwickeln und an der Spitze von Marketing und Werbung zu lernen. Vielfalt und Zusammenhalt leben wir durch zahlreiche Employee Resource Groups und regelmäßige interne Events - zum Austausch, zur Inspiration und zum gemeinsamen Feiern unserer Erfolge.
  
  
WPP Media ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit fördert. Wir berücksichtigen alle Bewerber:innen für alle Positionen ohne Diskriminierung. Unser Ziel ist eine Kultur des Respekts und der Zugehörigkeit, in der jede:r die gleichen Möglichkeiten hat, sich einzubringen und beruflich zu wachsen.
